scope_basis: The legacy network landscape view aggregates identifiers, relationships, interests, and salience across all locations. Filtering its rows by a location identifier does not scope those aggregates.
policy: Unassigned reports retain the canonical network view. Location reports use a dedicated projection whose operational aggregates include only explicit location/farm relationships and interests and verified location identifiers; salience is derived only through those location-scoped interests. Canonical party identity fields remain network-wide.
